name: Plastic Injection Molding | Norco Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Southern California's Premier Injection Molding Company | Large Tonnage Specialists Since 1974
about:
Norco Plastics, Inc. operates from an 88,000-square-foot facility in Chino, California. The company was founded in 1974 by the Williams family in nearby Norco, starting with just two machines. Today, the second generation of the family continues to lead the business, which has grown into one of Southern California's largest custom injection molding operations.

The shop runs 25 injection molding presses with clamping forces from 30 to 2,800 tons, including a 2,800-ton press installed in 2023 that enables production of very large parts. The facility operates 24/7 and employs about 60 people. Beyond molding, Norco provides secondary operations such as insert molding, hot stamping, robotic part removal, and assembly, plus supply-chain services including inventory management and logistics.

The company serves customers across Los Angeles, Riverside, Orange, San Bernardino, and San Diego counties. Its molded components go into construction (weather‑resistant barriers, structural fittings), storage and logistics (impact‑resistant totes and bins), consumer goods (food‑grade, BPA‑free housewares), agriculture (irrigation parts), automotive (tight‑tolerance fittings), and medical (non‑invasive devices, with cleanroom capability available).

Norco emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015‑compliant quality system, backed by a Brown & Sharpe CMM capable of ±0.0001‑inch measurement, and its 50‑year track record as a family‑owned, full‑service partner that can handle projects from prototype through high‑volume runs.
